---
applyTo: **/*.rb
---

Add a comment at the top of each Ruby file that describes the purpose of the file and any important details about its implementation. The comment should be concise, clear, and informative, providing context for future developers who may work on the code. In a new line after the comment, add a `# frozen_string_literal: true` directive to improve performance and reduce memory usage by freezing all string literals in the file.
